purpose: Resolve the three open questions of docs/android-design.md (phase 1) on Android emulators before implementation

tools.source: https://dl.google.com/android/repository/ (SHA-1 and size matched Google's repository metadata)
tools.license: Android Software Development Kit License Agreement, accepted by the owner for this test

connection_type.output_format: 4 hex digits of length, then protobuf text: device { serial state product model device connection_type transport_id }
connection_type.option_order: adb reads only the first option after track-devices; 'track-devices -l --proto-text' printed plain text without connection_type
connection_type.streaming: never exits; run_bounded timed out after 3 s as expected
connection_type.minimum_platform_tools_for_proto_text: not found in public release notes; detect the format at run time
connection_type.not_verified: connection_type on a USB-connected device (needs a real device)

commands.android_10_api_29: all design commands worked with ordinary adb permissions
commands.android_16_api_36: all design commands worked with ordinary adb permissions

formats.packages: package:<name> versionCode:<n>  installer=<value> uid:<n>; preinstalled apps show installer=null
formats.launcher: '<N> activities found:' then 'Activity #<n>:' blocks with 'package/class' lines, including short forms such as '/.AllInOneActivity'
formats.device_policy: per-user sections 'Enabled Device Admins (User <ID>, provisioningState: <n>):'; about 0.6 KB on Android 10 and 3.5 KB on Android 16

work_profile.created_with: pm create-user --profileOf 0 --managed (emulator only, no DPC app)
work_profile.accessibility_services: shared with the parent: the profile has no own value in 'settings list secure', and reads returned the parent's value even after writing a different one to the profile (Android 10)
work_profile.profile_parent: Android 16 'cmd user list -v' shows type=profile.MANAGED and parentId; Android 10 shows only the flags (0x20 = MANAGED_PROFILE)
work_profile.android_16_note: a nonexistent accessibility component written to the setting was removed by the system; Android 10 kept it

adb_server.no_server_running: adb started the server itself; the server left the process group, survived run_bounded's cleanup and did not hold the output open (no 'stayed open' error)
adb_server.first_command_after_start: error: device offline (the server had not reached the device yet)
adb_server.server_running: get-state and shell commands returned in about 0.04 s
adb_server.policy: leave the shared server running; wait for the device through track-devices updates
adb_server.not_verified: Windows: whether the Job Object stops the server when it closes

cleanup: emulators and the adb server were stopped; everything ran under a scratch HOME, and an empty ~/.android folder created by an early version check was removed

implementation_run.unmodified_check: refused both emulators: 'The device is not connected over USB (connection: SOCKET)' in about 0.4 s
implementation_run.usb_check_bypassed_in_test_only: the transport ID from adb was passed in place of the USB check; every other command ran for real

android_16.apps: completed; users 0 (full) and 10 (managed profile, parent 0); 349 system apps hidden, no user apps
android_16.privileged_access: completed; test notification listeners per user; accessibility of user 10 reported as shared with user 0
android_16.check: completed; 349 packages checked; real indicator file: 645 app packages (613 stalkerware, 35 watchware), generated 2026-10-09, fresh

android_10.users: managed profile and its parent inferred from flags (no parentId on Android 10)
android_10.privileged_access: short class '.OwnerService' expanded; inner class 'Work$Listener' kept; a real system notification listener read

implementation_run.not_reproducible_on_emulator: dumpsys device_policy with an enabled device admin (the AOSP image has no admin receivers)
